## Solution

**Setup.** For chamber $n$, the gas volume is $V_n(t) = t^n$, so the instantaneous rate of change is
$$V_n'(t) = n\,t^{n-1}.$$

At $t = 2$:
$$V_n'(2) = n \cdot 2^{n-1}.$$

**Average across all 10 chambers.**
$$x = \frac{1}{10}\sum_{n=1}^{10} n \cdot 2^{n-1}.$$

**Computing the sum.** Using the closed form $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{N} n\,r^{n-1} = \frac{1-(N+1)r^N + N\,r^{N+1}}{(1-r)^2}$ with $r=2$, $N=10$:

$$\sum_{n=1}^{10} n\cdot 2^{n-1} = \frac{1 - 11\cdot 2^{10} + 10\cdot 2^{11}}{(1-2)^2} = 1 - 11264 + 20480 = 9217.$$

**Verification by direct summation:**

| $n$ | $n\cdot 2^{n-1}$ |
|-----|------------------|
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 4 |
| 3 | 12 |
| 4 | 32 |
| 5 | 80 |
| 6 | 192 |
| 7 | 448 |
| 8 | 1024 |
| 9 | 2304 |
| 10 | 5120 |

Running total: $1+4+12+32+80+192+448+1024+2304+5120 = 9217$. ✓

**Final computation.**
$$x = \frac{9217}{10} = 921.7,$$
$$\lfloor 10^1 \cdot x \rfloor = \lfloor 10 \cdot 921.7 \rfloor = \lfloor 9217 \rfloor = \boxed{9217}.$$
